# Count - The platform for deep data exploration

> Count is an agentic analytics platform built for deep data exploration. Give its AI agent your data and a question, and it runs thousands of queries, produces hundreds of charts, and flags data quality issues — exploring your data further than any human could by hand, with every step auditable on an infinite canvas. The same canvas, compute layer, and agent power collaborative analytics, so teams build dashboards, reports, and data models together.

Website: https://count.co

## Product

Core product pages:

- [Agentic analytics](https://count.co/product/agentic-analytics)
  What agentic analytics is - using an AI agent as the primary interface to your data, so it does the analysis, not just the query - and why Count's auditable canvas, agent-speed compute layer and open context layer are built for it.
- [Count for data teams](https://count.co/product/data-teams)
  A collaborative workspace for data teams to investigate, model and explain the business, not just serve dashboards.
- [Count for growth teams](https://count.co/product/growth)
  A shared space for data-driven teams to work through complex questions and reach decisions faster - without Jira tickets.
- [Count for leaders](https://count.co/product/leaders)
  Ask AI anything about your business, work through the findings as a team and make decisions faster.

## Pricing

Transparent pricing. No base fees, no hidden costs. Viewer seats included in every tier.

Full pricing details: https://count.co/pricing

### Free - $0
For small teams or personal projects
- Up to 3 editor seats
- CSV database connections
- 3 canvases
- Count AI Agent (fair use)
- Python & SQL cells
- No-code visualizations
- Community support
- SOC2 & GDPR compliant

### Pro - $49/editor / month
For growing teams that need collaboration and integrations
Everything in Free, plus:
- 75 collaborators included
- 2 database connections
- Unlimited canvases & reports
- 2 alerts
- 14 day version history
- Domain whitelisting
- MCP support
- Email, Slack & Teams support

### Scale - $69/editor / month
For data-driven organizations that need more governance
Everything in Pro, plus:
- 250 collaborators included
- Unlimited database connections
- 8 GB compute layer capacity
- Scheduled query caching
- Full usage telemetry
- Unlimited version history
- Custom templates & fonts
- Embedding
- Okta SSO
- Canvas & query REST API

### Enterprise - Custom
For organizations with advanced security and compliance needs
Everything in Scale, plus:
- Unlimited everything
- 32 GB compute layer capacity
- Custom SSO
- HIPAA compliance
- Row-level security
- Data residency controls
- Workspace management REST API
- Disable exports
- SCIM provisioning
- Session control
- Custom training programs

### FAQ

**How does Count pricing compare to other BI tools?**
Unlike competitors, Count doesn't charge separately for viewer seats and offers no hidden fees. Viewers are included at every tier, and there are no base fees, setup charges, or implementation costs.

**What payment methods do you accept?**
All major debit and credit cards are accepted. You can manage billing directly from your workspace settings.

**How does Count reduce our compute costs?**
Count uses DuckDB technology to offload approximately 80% of day-to-day queries from your database, significantly reducing compute expenses.

**What are the different user roles?**
Analysts get full SQL, Python and low-code access to build manually or via our AI agent. Members and Viewers have limited editing capabilities but can collaborate within the canvas. Report Viewers can see the presentation layer only.

**Can I scale mid-month?**
Yes. You can add or remove seats at any time through your workspace settings. Changes are prorated automatically.

**What security certifications do you have?**
Count is SOC2, GDPR, and HIPAA certified with up-to-date security procedures. Your data is never used for training AI models.
